[[Heart of the Mountain]] Tier 4 |music = [[Hypixel SkyBlock OST#Going Even Deeper|''Going Even Deeper'']] |mobs = Butterfly |resources = *[[Hard Stone]] *[[Jasper]] *[[Jasper Crystal]] }} The '''Fairy Grotto''' is a [[Location]] that rarely spawns in the {{Zone|Crystal Hollows}}. It is one of the only two sources of {{Item|Jasper}}, the other being the {{Zone|Glacite Mineshafts}}: players can also find the {{Item|Jasper Crystal}} in [[Treasure Chest]]s or from killing {{MobSprite|Butterfly;Butterflies}}. Up to {{Green|3}} '''Fairy Grottos''' can spawn in a {{Zone|Crystal Hollows}} lobby. There is a {{Green|1/200}} chance of fishing up a {{Item|Fairy Soul}} from water in this location. This can be done twice. == Bugs == *Some '''Fairy Grottos''' do not say {{Zone|Fairy Grotto}} on the scoreboard, and it is not possible to fish up [[Fairy Souls]] in them. == History == {{History table |ahn= {{History|ahn-0.12-r1|Added '''Fairy Grotto'''.}} |beta= {{History|0.12|Added '''Fairy Grotto'''.}} }} == Navigation == {{Nav/Crystal Hollows}} {{Nav/Locations}}
